proposed_code: # PROPOSED INFECTIOUS AGENT EXTENSION CODES (XN) — 17 codes

label: Ehrlichia
justification: Genus-level code needed for ehrlichiosis LogDef; species E. chaffeensis (XN2X4) exists but genus does not

label: Bartonella
justification: Genus-level code for bartonellosis LogDef; species B. henselae/quintana exist but genus does not

label: Corynebacterium
justification: Genus-level code for non-diphtheriae corynebacterial infections

label: Leishmania donovani
justification: Visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar) agent; species-level needed for LogDef distinguishing clinical forms

label: Naegleria fowleri
justification: Primary amoebic meningoencephalitis; rare but clinically distinctive

label: Acanthamoeba
justification: Acanthamoeba keratitis; emerging cause of corneal infection

label: Human enterovirus 71
justification: Hand-foot-mouth disease agent; significant outbreak pathogen

label: Nipah virus
justification: WHO priority emerging pathogen; BSL-4; outbreak potential

label: Talaromyces marneffei
justification: Talaromycosis; reclassified from Penicillium; important in immunocompromised patients in SE Asia

label: Meninges
justification: Key site for meningitis localization; currently no dedicated XA code

label: Intestinal mucosa
justification: Site of mucosal invasion in dysentery (Shigella, Entamoeba, Salmonella)

label: Reticuloendothelial system
justification: Target of visceral leishmaniasis, brucellosis, histoplasmosis

label: Myocardium
justification: Chagas cardiomyopathy, viral myocarditis, rheumatic carditis
